title: A Wardrobe for the Weather
author: L. M. Eriksen
blurb: Sable Brightwater, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
